strokeOrderSource.variation: The independent-form handwriting animation draws the full be-series bowl first in one uninterrupted right-to-left run, then places the lower-left dot, the lower-right dot, and finally the lower-center dot: four strokes separated by three pen lifts. The adjacent prose identifies pe as the be-series shape with three dots below and requires a triangular arrangement whose two-dot side is closer to the main line. This learner path covers the independent form and fits the course's vendored Noto Naskh fallback; Urdu is conventionally printed in Nastaliq, and the app's true Nastaliq face remains separate from this canonical script-data fallback. The provenance remains Urdu-specific rather than borrowing the separate Persian پ source.
